reasoning_content: Now start display-server against the mock. Use docker run with the built image, env overrides, on shared-net, publish port. This uses the built artifact without modifying files.

action.command:
docker rm -f display-verify 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name display-verify --network shared-net -p 127.0.0.1:8001:8001 \
 -e API_BASE_URL=http://mock-backend:8002/api -e TENANT=demo \
 -e APP_USERNAME=u -e APP_PASSWORD=p -e BASE_PATH='' \
 display-server:latest && sleep 8 && echo "===LOGS===" && docker logs display-verify 2>&1 | tail -20
